en: The postcard features a black-and-white photographic collage. On the left, there is an entrance to a bathhouse facility, labeled 'Eingang zur Badeanstalt' with signage advertising various types of baths (Moor, Sool, Fichtennadel, Malz, Kleie, Wasserbäder). On the right, there is a courtyard with several connected buildings, signs reading 'BADEANSTALT,' and plant arrangements. The center bottom has handwritten German script and printed text identifying the location as 'Wiegands Badeanstalt.' The back side of the card says 'Deutsche Reichspost Postkarte' and is addressed to a person in Hannover, features a green postage stamp, and a museum marking from 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT.'
